rules.name: db-blockers
rules.sql: SELECT a.pid, a.usename, a.application_name, host(a.client_addr) AS client, a.state, a.wait_event_type, a.wait_event, date_trunc('second', now() - a.xact_start)::text AS xact_age, date_trunc('second', now() - a.query_start)::text AS query_age, pg_blocking_pids(a.pid)::text AS blocked_by, left(regexp_replace(a.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 400) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity a WHERE a.datname = current_database() AND a.pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND a.backend_type = 'client backend' AND a.state <> 'idle' ORDER BY a.xact_start NULLS LAST

SELECT w.pid AS waiting_pid, w.usename AS waiting_user, w.application_name AS waiting_app, w.wait_event_type, w.wait_event, date_trunc('second', now() - w.query_start)::text AS waiting_for, b.pid AS blocking_pid, b.usename AS blocking_user, b.application_name AS blocking_app, b.state AS blocking_state, date_trunc('second', now() - b.xact_start)::text AS blocking_xact_age, left(regexp_replace(w.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 300) AS waiting_query, left(regexp_replace(b.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 300) AS blocking_query FROM pg_stat_activity w CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pg_blocking_pids(w.pid)) AS bp(pid) JOIN pg_stat_activity b ON b.pid = bp.pid WHERE w.datname = current_database() ORDER BY w.query_start

expect.reason: no session is waiting on another one

rules.sql: SELECT l.pid, l.mode, l.granted, l.classid, l.objid, a.application_name, a.state, date_trunc('second', now() - a.xact_start)::text AS xact_age, left(regexp_replace(a.query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 200) AS query FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid WHERE l.locktype = 'advisory' AND l.database = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) ORDER BY l.granted, a.xact_start

SELECT 'this connection' AS scope, name, setting, unit FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('lock_timeout', 'statement_timeout', 'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout', 'idle_session_timeout', 'deadlock_timeout', 'log_lock_waits', 'log_min_duration_statement') UNION ALL SELECT coalesce('role ' || r.rolname, 'all roles') || coalesce(' in ' || d.datname, ''), cfg, NULL, NULL FROM pg_db_role_setting s LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = s.setrole LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = s.setdatabase CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.setconfig) AS cfg WHERE d.datname IS NULL OR d.datname = current_database() ORDER BY 1, 2
